subtitle: A 3.5-mile Pacific beach on San Francisco's west side where a new park opened to crowds and cost its champion his job.
spike_statement: San Francisco closed a scenic highway for Sunset Dunes park at Ocean Beach in 2025, then voters recalled the supervisor who championed it.

levers.photo_tone: Fog-hazed dune path along the former Great Highway, cool gray-blue light, the ocean reduced to a silver smear.
